answer: In an agent economy funding a grove, a yarrow nursery, and canyon restoration, votes on payments are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, not by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. To control a majority, an attacker must lock more stake than all honest voters combined, tying up capital and bearing token-price risk for the full lock period.
